C0320.title: City's First Case: Prosecutors Unravel Scheme of Mass Game Account Registration with Real-Name Verification
C0320.summary: In 2024, suspect Ma used self-written programs to bypass Game Company A platform protections, used SMS receiving software to obtain phone numbers and verification codes, automatically registered blank game accounts in bulk, and used illegally obtained citizens personal information for real-name verification. The accounts were then handed to Liu for external sale and profit, and prosecutors became involved in review and prosecution. The case shows an account black-market chain combining SMS receiving, automated registration, and misuse of real-name identity data.
